animation.guide.faq.a1: Please check: ① Is the light show switch turned on? ② Is the keyboard checked in "Devices"? ③ Does the keyboard firmware version meet the requirements? ④ Is there any light effect bound to this device?
animation.guide.faq.a2AnimDesc: Are visual elements on the canvas (such as spectrum bars, particles), whose colors are sampled and overlaid on the keyboard. They work best when used together.
animation.guide.faq.a2EffectDesc: Directly calculates the color of each key (such as breathing, rainbow, lightning, etc.), which is the actual display effect of the keyboard.
animation.guide.faq.a3: The light show is rendered by the HUB main process in the background to ensure continuous operation of the lighting effects. If not needed, you can turn off the light show switch.
animation.guide.faq.a4: 30 Hz is recommended for balancing smoothness and performance. If your computer has good specifications, you can set it to 60 Hz; if specifications are low, you can lower it to 15~20 Hz.
animation.guide.faq.a5: Use the gaming lighting effects (shot flash, step radar, reload wave, explosion impact). They will automatically detect game audio events. Make sure the system audio output is normal.
animation.guide.faq.a6: Complete scene state saved: All animations (type, color, parameters, position) + all lighting effects (type, color, parameters, on/off state) + global settings (frequency, etc.).
